topic: Someone finds their childhood teddy bear at a yard sale
text: I wandered through the yard sale's sprawl of forgotten things, my fingers dancing over the years lain bare. There, in a wicker basket tooled with the patina of time, my gaze collided with the round, button-eyed face of my old teddy. His fur, once a plush cream, was now dulled by time, threads of past cuddles unraveling softly. The moment seemed to swell, a pocket of warmth against the day’s chill. Without thought, I clutched him close, the world fading into the backdrop of a childhood remembered. Each thread, each stitch, a whisper of stories once shared in the hush of my room, now held in the delicate embrace of this relic. I paid the asking price, a small fortune for an old toy, but in my arms, I held the world.
